title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Under Starry Night Sky Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom with the Custom Trucker Bedding Set, brought to you by Jeminise. This modern comforter set is designed specifically for trucking enthusiasts, featuring a striking graphic illustration of a semi-truck under a starry night sky. Perfect as a cozy addition to your bed or as a thoughtful, personalized gift for family and friends, this bedding set allows you to enter a custom name to make it truly unique.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this trucker bedding with your own text input, such as a name, to create a one-of-a-kind look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from standard US bedding sizes including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Features one duvet cover or comforter, with the option to add matching pillowcases or a flat sheet.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry without heat or tumble dry on low heat for quick fluffing.
  • Superior Craftsmanship: Smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges ensures long-lasting durability and color vibrancy.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Love Trucker
Theme Trucker
Pattern Cartoon
Style Modern
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
